description: Each hospital's charges for a (code_type, code), one row per hospital and group of the group_by grouping (default: per billing class, methodology and setting; GROUP_BY_ALL gives one row per hospital), paginated. The billing-class-aware counterpart to list_hospital_code_costs, good for 'which hospital is cheapest for X'. Defaults/caps page_size at 500; includes total_count and hospital_count. Backed by the hospital-prices serving snapshot; fails with UNAVAILABLE until the server has opened one.

code_type.description: Code system the billing code belongs to, e.g. APR-DRG, CDM, CPT, HCPCS, MS-DRG, RC.

filter.description: Keeps only some of the grouped rows (see group_by). Each field left out matches any value; set a field (even to its *_UNSPECIFIED value, which means 'not filed') to require it. Billing classes are never blended: a facility fee and a professional fee are separate bills.

group_by.description: Which rows exist: one per billing class + methodology + setting (GROUP_BY_PER_COMBINATION, the default), per billing class, per methodology, or GROUP_BY_ALL (one figure over everything, blending billing classes). Applied before filter, which may name only the terms the grouping still keeps (e.g. GROUP_BY_BILLING_CLASS with a methodology filter, or GROUP_BY_ALL with any filter, is rejected as INVALID_ARGUMENT).

min_sample_count.description: Only rows backed by at least this many billing records (compared against the sample count's lower bound). Negative values are rejected.

order_by.description: Defaults to relevance when query is set, hospital id otherwise.

page_token.description: Opaque next_page_token from a previous response; only valid with the same request fields.

name: list_code_provider_hospitals
title: List hospitals' provider charges for a code
